channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: US strikes Iranian site; Kuwait targeted by missiles, drones
item.description: Kuwait's military says air defences are battling 'hostile' missiles and drones, as alarms sound across the country.

item.title: Markets rally amid hopes of US-Iran deal
item.description: Markets betting a deal will reopen the Strait of Hormuz and soothe the deep global economic uncertainty.

item.title: Why is Israel ramping up attacks in Lebanon despite a ceasefire?
item.description: Intensification comes while US-Iran indirect talks continue.

item.title: Trump says no one will control Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Donald Trump says he won’t allow Iran to control ⁠the Strait of ⁠Hormuz under the terms of any deal reached with Tehran.

item.title: Trump appears to threaten Oman over Strait of Hormuz impasse
item.description: The US president warns that Oman, a US ally, 'will behave just like everybody else, or we will have to blow them up'.

item.title: Iran government sells subsidised meat for Eid al-Adha under blockade
item.description: Iranians are seeing the price of meat, and other basics, escalate due to the US blockade and sanctions.

item.title: US strikes Iran targets for second time in three days
item.description: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

item.title: Israel issues evacuation order for swathes of southern Lebanon
item.description: The military says areas south of the Zahrani River are now "combat zones" as it threatens Hezbollah with fresh strikes.

item.title: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills new head of Hamas's military wing
item.description: Hamas says Mohammed Odeh was killed alongside his wife and two children in a strike on a residential building.

item.title: Oil prices jump after US launches new attacks on Iran
item.description: The strikes come despite a ceasefire between Tehran and Washington as the two countries hold peace talks.
